name: Managing Information as a Strategic Resource
notes: Establishes general policy for federal information management including security, privacy, and records management. Requires agencies to implement NIST standards.

derives_from.note: FISMA directs OMB to oversee agency information security programs.
Implements Privacy Act requirements for federal information systems.

references.note: Directs agencies to apply NIST security controls.
Requires use of FIPS 199 for security categorization.
